problems.note: Card 6 ('Now let's practise with Mia! Use your fingers to help.') has no question or number to solve, so a child gets no task. Add a short question, such as 'Mia has 4 apples. 2 more come. How many now?', or drop the card.

Card 4 says 5 apples are red and 2 are green, but the ten-frame with 7 dots shows no colours. A child listening can't match the red/green split to the picture. Either the picture should show two colour groups, or the narration should say the picture is just 7 dots.
Narration says 5 balloons are red and the rest are blue, but the ten-frame with 7 dots has no colours, so the picture can't show the split. Same fix as story card 4.

Two operations in one item (5 + 3 - 2) is a step above the other Kindergarten items. It stays within 10, so it is valid, but it is harder than difficulty 3 suggests for by-ear play. Consider moving it to a later skill or marking it harder.

There is no picture, and the question asks how many more by comparing two groups. A child who hears only the narration has to hold 8 and 5 in memory. A ten-frame or row of emoji for each child would make the comparison easier to follow.
